title: Insteel Industries Reports Second Quarter 2026 Results
summary: Insteel Industries Inc. (NYSE: IIIN) (“Insteel” or the “Company”), the largest manufacturer of steel wire reinforcing products for concrete construction applications in the United States, today reported financial results for its second quarter of fiscal 2026, ended March 28, 2026. Second Quarter 2026 Highlights Net earnings of $5.2 million, or $0.27 per share Net sales of $172.7 million Gross profit of $16.5 million, or 9.6% of net sales Net cash balance of $15.1 million and no debt outstanding as of March 28, 2026 Weather-driven volume decline, while market outlook remains positive Second Quarter 2026 Results Net earnings for the second quarter of fiscal 2026 decreased to $5.2 million, or $0.27 per share, from $10.2 million, or $0.52 per diluted share, in the same period a year ago.
